items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: the one that I saw was Flip Phillips had a tenor

ctx.x: And I knew it was going to be. I just had a feeling that this was going to be great. Did you ever take a globe and draw your path? You know, because I think you should, because I think it’s really interesting. You know, Australia, England, France — and now you’re here at Fredonia.

Well the one that I saw was Flip Phillips had a tenor and he had engravings on the bell and the bowl of a bus and a little plane and a railroad train, and he had dates on all of these things, and his whole life on the horn. But I’m having a wonderful time, and I couldn’t think of a better way to have done it.
Great. Well on that positive note, I want to thank you very much.
